title: Message
description: A draft or a sent message. The compliance checks are part of the object, not an external step.

touch_number.description: Which touch this message is, counted per account.
touch_number.$comment: The effective limit is the `touch_cap_per_account` configuration slot (reference default: 2). The schema bound is 3, the highest value that slot may take.

template_id.description: The template this message was built from.
template_id.$comment: Open string. The reference motion used five: first_touch_reference, follow_up_single, no_show_recovery, slot_confirmation, post_call_recap. A workspace declares its own set; the schema does not close it.

personalization_fact.description: The specific fact cited in the first line. Mandatory on first touches.

cta.description: One per message. Wording comes from the `cta_wording` slot, the count from `cta_count_per_message` (reference default: 1).

utm_content.description: The account domain. Required at the first mention of the product, per the `tracked_link_policy` slot.

compliance_checks.description: All required checks true is a necessary condition to deliver the draft. A false value blocks delivery; it does not produce a warning.

single_cta.description: Exactly one call to action in the message body.

tracked_link_present.description: A tracked product link at the first product mention, carrying the account domain.

claims_approved.description: Every assertion is drawn from the ratified `approved_claims` list.

no_duplicate_draft.description: No other live draft exists for the same idempotency key (account_id, template_id, thread_id).

language_checks.description: Register checks that depend on the customer language.
language_checks.$comment: Supplied by the active language adapter (`references/languages/`), selected by the `customer_language` slot and populated from `banned_tokens` and `allowed_exceptions`. Which of these keys exist, and whether they are required, is the adapter's decision, not the schema's.

no_em_dash.description: No em-dash in output prose. Banned in every language the reference motion shipped.

no_anglicisms.description: No English loanwords in customer-facing copy beyond the declared exceptions. Applies to the Italian adapter; the English adapter has no equivalent.

status.description: superseded covers the real case of the ACCOUNT-C draft made obsolete by a manual send.

reply_class.$comment: Closed and universal. auto_reply is never interest: the class exists so that an out-of-office cannot advance a state.

reply_quote.description: Literal quotation. Forbids the paraphrase that inflates interest.

human_edited.description: True if the founder edited the draft before sending: input for the learning loop.
